MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 AND t.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.loggedAt<datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND (i.resolutionName IS NULL OR i.resolutionName='')
WITH i, sum(t.seconds) AS v, collect(t.historyId) AS tids
ORDER BY v DESC
WITH collect({i:i,v:v,t:tids}) AS all
WITH all, all[4].v AS cut
UNWIND all AS r
WITH r WHERE r.v>=cut
MATCH (r.i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
UNWIND r.t AS tid
RETURN r.i.issueKey AS id, r.v AS value, pr.projectKey AS project, tid

MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 AND t.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.loggedAt<datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND (i.resolutionName IS NULL OR i.resolutionName='')
WITH i, sum(t.seconds) AS v, collect(t.historyId) AS tids
ORDER BY v DESC
WITH collect({i:i,v:v,t:tids}) AS all
WITH all, all[4].v AS cut
UNWIND all AS r
WITH r WHERE r.v>=cut
WITH r, r.i AS iss
MATCH (iss)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
UNWIND r.t AS tid
RETURN iss.issueKey AS id, r.v AS value, pr.projectKey AS project, tid

MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 AND t.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.loggedAt<datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND (i.resolutionName IS NULL OR i.resolutionName='')
MATCH (i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
RETURN i.issueKey AS id, sum(t.seconds) AS value, pr.projectKey AS project, collect(t.historyId) AS tid ORDER BY value DESC

MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 AND t.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.loggedAt<datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND (i.resolutionName IS NULL OR i.resolutionName='')
MATCH (i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
WITH i.issueKey AS issue, pr.projectKey AS project, t.historyId AS te, sum(t.seconds) AS s
WITH issue, project, collect(te) AS tes, sum(s) AS value
UNWIND tes AS time_entry
RETURN issue, project, value, time_entry ORDER BY value DESC
